purpose: Development comparison: does recommended sampling improve component repair over greedy decoding?
changed_variable: Repair decoding: sample with temperature 0.7, top_p 0.8, top_k 20 and min_p 0, instead of greedy.
unchanged: Source, repair messages, full browser tests, critic protocol, 6144 output-token cap, repetition_penalty=1.05. No training.
primary_measure: Full audit and valid measured-critic acceptance after one repair; retain all failures.
next_step_rule: Do not run fresh held-out briefs unless development evidence supports improvement. A three-case result alone cannot prove high reliability.
